bootSpec.text:
MOTION · BOOT LOADER

Logo glitch burst: every 3200ms, 4-frame RGB split · ease/glitch.
Log lines type in: 600ms steps(24); caret 1s steps(1) (MI-05).
Progress segments fill one per 5%; leading block white.
ENTER + sound toggle appear at 100%: motion/slow cyber-out, 12px rise.
ENTER → flash to magenta, motion/cinematic, then hero.
Sound toggle = SD-01 / SD-03.

Reduced motion: no glitch, no typing, caret steady, fades only.

navSpec.text:
MOTION · NAV

SC-07 transparent → glass at 24px, motion/base cyber-out.
Links: MI-03 text scramble + underline sweep motion/base.
JACK IN: MT-04 magnetic 6px + MI-01 glitch flash.
Hamburger → X: motion/base cyber-out.
Overlay: clip reveal motion/slow; links stagger 60ms, slide 32px.
Add SD-03 sound toggle beside the clock.

Reduced motion: instant states, fade overlay.

charSpec.text:
MOTION · CHARACTERS

MT-03 tilt ≤ 10°, shine follows pointer, release motion/slow cyber-out.
Portrait → glitched alt: crossfade motion/fast, jitter 900ms steps(4).
Click → dossier: clip reveal top→bottom motion/slow; WANTED stamp lands +300ms, scale 1.6→1.
MT-01 label: VIEW.
Mobile: swipe snap-x; tap = hover state.

Reduced motion: no tilt, no jitter, dossier fades.

loreSpec.text:
MOTION · LORE

SC-04: line scaleY scrubbed to scroll; head dot glows cyan↔magenta 900ms.
Node reached at 50% viewport: fill + ring pulse (MI-06) + one-off ping 1200ms.
Card: opacity .18→1 and slide 32px in motion/slow cyber-out.
Ghost year outline brightens with the node.

Reduced motion: line fully drawn, all cards visible.

gallerySpec.text:
MOTION · GALLERY

Hover / focus: image zoom 1.05 motion/slow cyber-out; scanlines fade in motion/fast and drift 1200ms linear; caption slides up motion/base.
Filter: tiles fade/re-flow motion/base.
Lightbox: open scale .97→1 motion/base; ← → Esc F keys; mobile swipe 40px threshold.
MT-01 label: VIEW.

Reduced motion: no zoom or drift; caption shown on hover/focus.

joinSpec.text:
MOTION · JOIN

Background S-03 tunnel (CSS stand-in here).
Focus: glow ring motion/fast.
Error: MI-04 shake 400ms ease/glitch + glitching error text; aria-live.
Loading: 16 segments chase 1200ms steps(1); button disabled.
Success: card scales in motion/slow; 40 neon pixel confetti fall 1.6–3.4s steps(18); tunnel speeds up ×6 for motion/cinematic.
SD-02 key ticks if sound ON.

Reduced motion: no shake, no confetti, static rings.

footerSpec.text:
MOTION · FOOTER + 404

Ticker: 28s linear loop, pauses on hover.
Wordmark: outline fills on hover motion/slow; glitch slice every 5s steps.
404 headline: RGB slice glitch 2400ms steps(1).
Hologram: flicker 3200ms steps(1); 6 bands jitter steps(3) 1.2–3.1s; dashed ring spins 10s.

Reduced motion: all static, hologram at 80% opacity.

bpHeroN.text:
HERO · WHAT CHANGES

390: text stacks at the bottom over a 97% → 0 scrim; H1 3 lines 44px; CTAs full width; buildings −60%; wet-street reflections off; parallax 50% (gyro opt-in); scroll cue centred.

834: still bottom-stacked on the scrim (portrait framing); H1 2 lines 68px; CTAs in a row; nav = overlay; touch so no mouse parallax.

1440: reference — text left on a side scrim, mouse parallax, cue bottom-right.

1920: H1 132px, 160px margins, text block max 1360px, parallax ×1.2.

All: low-power → poster image; reduced motion → static frame.

bpAugN.text:
AUGMENTS · WHAT CHANGES

390: canvas top 380px; details in a bottom sheet (peek 392 / full 724). Tapping a hotspot opens its part info inside the sheet, not a floating callout. Touch-drag rotate; pinch zoom OFF. Augment switcher = 3 icon buttons on the canvas edge.

834: canvas full width (754×480), details panel below, thumbnails at the bottom; callouts float; touch-drag.

1440: canvas left 820×560, details right.

1920: canvas 1040×680, model 1.2×, details column 500px.

No WebGL: turntable MP4 / still per augment.

bpJoinN.text:
JOIN · WHAT CHANGES

390: copy stacked above a full-width terminal; perks list hidden; 34px H2; tunnel rings at lower opacity behind a darker vignette.

834: copy centred above a 640px terminal; perks shown.

1440: copy left, 600px terminal right.

1920: 80px H2, 680px terminal, 120px column gap, content max 1600px.

All: fields 48px tall, checkbox and buttons ≥ 44px; error/success announced via aria-live; reduced motion → no shake, no confetti, static rings.

augmentsSpec.text:
VIEWER HAND-OFF

Canvas: Three.js + OrbitControls, Y-axis only (±180°), damping 0.08, auto-rotate 6°/s after 4s idle. Arrow buttons step 45°. Pinch / wheel zoom 0.8–1.4×.

Hotspots: 3D anchors projected to screen each frame; hidden when the anchor faces away (dot < −0.2). Tap opens a HUD callout; one open at a time; Esc closes.

Finish swatches swap the emissive + trim material (cyan / magenta / chrome) — the pedestal beam and stat bars follow the finish.

EQUIP toggles to EQUIPPED (green). Thumbnails swap the GLB with a 300ms dissolve.

Mobile: canvas top 380px, details in a bottom sheet — peek 392px (name, price, finish, EQUIP), drag up to 724px for stats + specs. EQUIP pinned to the sheet footer.

Reduced motion: no float, no auto-rotate, no ring spin.

districtsSpec.text:
SCROLL-JACK (DESKTOP)

Section pins for 4 × 100vh. Each 25% of pinned scroll (or 80px of wheel, or ←/→) advances one card; the track slides 528px with motion/slow cyber-out. Pin releases after card 04 and before card 01, so the page never traps the user.

Active card: scale 1.06, cyan border + glow/cyan, full colour. Others: 0.92, 60% opacity, desaturated.

Hover: key art zooms 1.05, cyan/magenta copies split ±6–10px with steps(4) slice jitter, ENTER arrow slides out, SIGNAL INTERFERENCE tag.

MOBILE: native vertical scroll-snap (y mandatory, snap-stop always), dots on the right track the snapped card. Press = hover effect.

Reduced motion: no pin, no jitter — static 4px split and a plain list.

SPEC IDs: SC-03 · SC-05 · MT-01 (DRAG) · MI-01

heroSpec.text:
THREE.JS HAND-OFF

Mouse → camera parallax: camera.position.x/y lerp toward pointer (±0.4 units, 600ms cyber-out). Layer depth = parallax strength: far 6px · mid 14 · cars 20 · near 32 · rain 40. Text counter-shifts 4px.

Scroll → fly forward: first 100vh of scroll maps camera z 0 → −400. Near towers pass the lens, car trails and rain speed up, H1 group rises and fades out by 40%.

Fixed: CTAs, HUD corners, nav. Scroll cue fades after 5%.

Mobile: gyro parallax (opt-in, 50%), same scroll dive. Reduced motion: static poster frame.

CSS city here is a stand-in for the WebGL scene.
